purpose: Check ordinary index-worker progress during later source publications, not token or load acceptance
driver: one native index protocol process; direct durable original PageMap publications
assertions: At least one later publication overlaps each index request
Each request acknowledges successful completion of an older pinned source
Later publications remain unprepared until catch-up
An already opened lexical reader remains unchanged
One final ordinary worker request catches up to the latest source
Final lexical postings match independent full-source tokenization
Final window owners match independent full original-window census
All original and focus numerical windows are valid
The worker exits cleanly without source-change or matrix-change invalidation errors
